cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(kvhttp LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

add_executable(app src/main.cpp src/http.cpp src/router.cpp)
target_compile_options(app PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE Threads::Threads)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimised release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

if command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null
  cmake --build build --parallel
  cp build/app ./app
else
  "${CXX:-c++}" -std=c++20 -O2 -DNDEBUG -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -pthread \
    src/main.cpp src/http.cpp src/router.cpp -o app
fi
